Hi! I’m Ariana, an undergraduate studying Geophysics at UCSB. I’m passionate about seismology, tectonics, and understanding the Earth's mantle.

Right now, I’m exploring anti-repeating earthquakes in the Californian Sierra Valley and building my skills in Python and Fortran. Outside the classroom, you can usually find me swimming at the Recreation Center.

Take a look at my recent work on the **Projects** page, or feel free to reach out—I’d love to connect!
